differences.native: MySQL converts each timestamp to epoch seconds with TIMESTAMPDIFF and floors the summed day count.
differences.app: SQLite obtains the same epoch seconds with strftime and truncates the nonnegative day count with an INTEGER cast.
differences.rationale: SQLite lacks TIMESTAMPDIFF and FLOOR in the bundled runtime. The signed event sum and division by 86400 are otherwise identical; total uptime is nonnegative, so truncation equals floor.
